semantics: Only completed natural child RETURN labels recorded before administrative stop train the replay.
Each request contributes at most one median residual to each predicted-work band; 64 recent requests per band, with same-project donors excluded.
A label becomes available only at recorded child RETURN. No future completion, same-request outcome or canceled request label is used as an input.
The existing delivered semantic score, notice, service progress and rate remain fixed. This median-residual pilot does not retrain the encoder or phase classifier.
This is one trace development replay with fixed candidate bands, not heldout model qualification, actual runtime trigger replay or a policy selected by measured gains.
Sampled horizons lack the current tree, capacity, service-estimator and enqueue checks. EOS lead is not guaranteed child RETURN lead or an H2D benefit.
Administrative unresolved requests remain unresolved. No production forecast, lease, physical data dependency or frozen V44 code is changed.
